steps.title: Tests: canonical OG cases for AC-1 to AC-8
Canonical OG: scope guard and retirements
Canonical OG: frontmatter parser, B+ writer, type map
Canonical OG: schema v1, config, CLI renames
Canonical harness flows: launch, reindex-graph, patch apply
Canonical docs flow: writers, rules, templates
Implementation Harness E2E: follow the key rename
Release: commit, minor version stamp, patch prepare
Web Docs: nav and README links

intervals.detail: Step 10: developer commits canonical, E2E and report before the version stamp
Step 11: developer commit chore(implementation-harness): apply 4.2.0 patch
Step 12: developer commit chore(docs): migrate docs to OKF 0.2 knowledge base
Steps 13-14: developer preview checks (Graph Explorer tiers, Dogfood page)
Test review: RF-032 version (high), RF-037 OG tests in CI
